item.title: Documentation as Tooling - The Ops Tool
item.description: 1. What Documentation as Tooling Means “Documentation as tooling, tooling as a product” is a slogan I have repeated many times in my previous blog posts. A good document is no match for a tool that is pleasant to use. A script or a single command is more direct than reading documentation and can solve the problem faster.
